items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And then we made a couple of records with Eddie Condon over Columbia Records

ctx.x: what you change it to, you'll find out, you can't wait forever to find out you have to come back directly to find out, it seemed like. 'Cause by the time you try to get the gags to fit the personalities, you could starve to death.

We had a good stay, westayed at the Palladium two weeks and come back. I had a beautiful time over there. The funniest thing about it, while we were over there we made the first broadcast of television for BBC. That's in 1930. We're now in 1930. And BBC made the first broadcast on television, BBC. Right. And then we made a couple of records with Eddie Condon over Columbia Records -- and what else did we do?
You made the records in England or --
